specRef.note: Not shipped in this package. Alchemy stores the definition only; the battle-runtime spec is authored with the platform's battle-infra generator and executed by Arena in its own account.

scenario.startingState: A two-tier web app runs on one EC2 instance in a single subnet behind an Application Load Balancer that only has one subnet attached.
scenario.mission: Make the application survive the loss of its Availability Zone without changing the application code.
successConditions: The ALB has subnets in at least two Availability Zones.
At least one healthy target exists in each of two Availability Zones.
The app answers HTTP 200 while the original AZ's instances are stopped.
